territories.name: Jordan
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Jordan levies a general sales tax of its own under the General Sales Tax Law No. 6 of 1994 as amended: article 6 sets the general rate at sixteen per cent, article 7 zero-rates exports and the supplies of the second schedule and exempts those of the third, article 16 has a registered person file a two-month return, and the Income and Sales Tax Department takes it.
